visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed rotating homepage hero: each slide shows a background image with date, headline, summary and CTA, with a row of story tabs (slide titles), prev/next and pause/play controls

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cell 1 = background image; cell 2 = date/eyebrow paragraph, heading (h1/h2, also used as the tab label), description paragraph and a CTA link. Missing image or extra cells are tolerated

usage: Homepage top hero with several featured stories that rotate automatically.
reuseGuidance: Use for multi-story rotating heroes. For a single static hero use hero-page; for an image-only slider use carousel-gallery.
